items.title: 19.8 Mechanisms of Chemical Reactions (chemical reactions ke mechanisms) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 19.8, PDF pages 50-51.

blocks.text: Mechanism woh raasta (pathway) hai jis par reaction chalta hai; yeh dikhata hai ke product banne tak substrate mein kaun se bonds toot'te aur kaun se bante hain. Reagents ki type ke lihaz se mechanisms ki do bari types hain:
